theme: Surveil basics and simple card selection
reuse: Surveil: game SurveilKeyedForEffect (222 surveil cards on develop — copy a sibling); 'costs {2} less if it targets an attacking creature': cost_modifier.go target-conditional; return from graveyard at upkeep (Master of Death); 'draw three, then discard two unless you discard an enchantment card' — same sentence as Arm-Mounted Anchor (batch 21): grep 'unless you discard'.

cards.name: Sinister Starfish
cards.oracle_text: {T}: Surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Notion Rain
cards.oracle_text: Surveil 2, then draw two cards. Notion Rain deals 2 damage to you. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Curate
cards.oracle_text:
Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Draw a card.

cards.name: Nightveil Sprite
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature attacks, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

cards.name: Ephara's Dispersal
cards.oracle_text:
This spell costs {2} less to cast if it targets an attacking creature.
Return target creature to its owner's hand. Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Master of Death
cards.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, if this card is in your graveyard, you may pay 1 life. If you do, return it to your hand.

cards.name: Telling Time
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top three cards of your library. Put one of those cards into your hand, one on top of your library, and one on the bottom of your library.

cards.name: Diabolic Vision
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on top of your library in any order.

cards.name: Thirst for Meaning
cards.oracle_text: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard an enchantment card.

cards.name: Keep Watch
cards.oracle_text: Draw a card for each attacking creature.
